pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE TEMPTATIONS OF JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.2: The Temptations of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Temptations of Jesus Christ
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How did Jesus Christ overcome the temptations He faced in the wilderness?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify temptations they face as young people today

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify temptations they face as young people today

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify temptations they face as young people today.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify temptations they face as young people today” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify temptations they face as young people today” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify temptations they face as young people today" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify temptations they face as young people today

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify temptations they face as young people today

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did Jesus Christ overcome the temptations He faced in the wilderness?
2. How do you overcome temptations as a young person?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify temptations they face as young people today

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
